extraction.Name: Armine Turgeon
extraction.Buyer: Sold in favor of Otto Nightingale, Fairfax, S. D. for $1000 (mortgaged with other land for $18000)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I mortgaged it with some other land and was going to lose it so I sold it with some other land for $1000
extraction.Occupation/Income: I live in the town of Bonesteel and take in boarders do fancy work and other small chores then the children help me some
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent by mail; allottee did not ask for the patent; signed the mortgage of her own accord thinking the land would be redeemed; signed deed in summer of 1928; at present is not satisfied with the deal; health is fair; has three children all married; sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on 1st day of May 1929; document number 001940
